6.description: [Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [Gruul the Dragonkiller]: Gruul now casts Hurtful Strike whenever he does an auto attack. Previously he would cast Hurtful Strike on a timer.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [Gruul the Dragonkiller]: Gruul will now grow every 30 seconds up from 24 seconds. Gruul no longer delays or cancels his growth when casting Shatter.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Kroshs Mirror Shield will not mirror Spell Steal.

[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Krosh's Spell Reflection is now called Mirror Shield. Mirror Shield will "Mirror" any harmful spell used against a council member, mirroring the spell onto the caster. Mirror Shield can mirror area effects and unlike the previous reflect will not inherit the casting players damage modifications. Mirror Shield can't mirror more often then once per second.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Corrected an issue where Olm's Soulstones sometimes would not trigger.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Kiggler and Krosh can walk again.

[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Improved the caster AI of High King Maulgar and all of his council members. The Council will now execute spells and events without having to cancel or skip other events. All full caster on the council will now attempt to stay within a certain distance of their targets.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: High King Maulgar now deals damage 50% faster but inflicts 50% less during Bladestorm.

[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Corrected an issue where Maulgars Bladestorm had less range then his combat reach, causing him to not hit the target he chased while blade storming if the target would just stand still.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Maulgar found out hitting with weapons is more effective then hitting with his bare hands and now uses his new axes when enraged.
[Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [High King Maulgar]: Maulgar has a new hammer.

5.description: [Pending restart and cache clear] Hammer of the Naaru has been buffed and adjusted to more clearly be a hybrid weapon.
[Pending restart and cache clear] Fixed an issue where Bloodforged Medallion of the Horde/Alliance had Resilience listed twice.

0.description: The Essence of Blood quest on the callboard is no longer available during TBC because Essence of Blood can not be obtained during TBC.
There should now be 6 daily profession quests in TBC up from 5, matching the vanilla counterpart.
[Pending Restart] - Callboard Daily quests for Profession Quests will now reward 8,000 marks instead of 5,000 on Elune.
[Area-52] [Elune] Reduced the health of Ur'zul Fiend's from The Many-Faced Devourer's manastorm by 25%.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Drakhacrisp now deals 40% reduced damage in PvP combat when affected by Fire Arsenal.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] The debuff from Flesh Hook that prevents other Flesh Hooks from being used on the same target now only applies in PvP combat.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Infused Energy would increase the periodic damage of abilities while the buff was active.

5.description: [Pending restart and cache clear] The stats on Eye of Gruul have been buffed. It now has more spell power than before and also has some haste rating.

1.description: Fixed a bug where Shadowtep could break Prowl.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Area-52] [Prayer of Mending] - Fixed a bug where Prayer of Mending would sometimes heal more than intended.
[Pending Restart]: Corrected an issue where Nether Protection could not proc from certain spell types, primarly spells used by Raid and Dungeon Bosses.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Endless Lightning was incorrectly affecting Fulmination and Forked Lightning. These are available for reset at Gabril Mewell.

[Elune] [Vessel of Destruction] - New talent: Fel Flame Weapon further empowers its wielder, causing Fel Cleave, Felblade and Annihilan Decimation to increase the Fire and Shadow damage taken from the caster by 5%(2% against players), and Fel Flame Weapon by another 12% against monsters. Stacking 8 times. Lasts 20 seconds. The duration of Vessel of Destruction cannot be refreshed and requires wielding a single two-handed weapon.

[Elune] [Interrogator's Immolate] - The Immolation cast time reduction can now also be triggered by Bloodthirst, the damage from Fanatic Flames now also triggers from Bloodthirst damage. The proc chance has been increased to 33% up from 25%.

[Elune] [Annihilan Decimation] - After reviewing community feedback Annihilan Decimation has seen some changes. Annihilan Combo no longer resets the cooldown of Annihilan Decimation, instead Felblade and Fel Cleave reduce the cooldown of Annihilan Decimation by 9 seconds, it's cooldown has been increased to 20 seconds. Annihilan Combo can now also be activated by Fel Cleave, in addition to Felblade. These changes aim to make the rotation flow better if you're not playing a dot heavy variant.
[Elune] [Fel Cleave] - Fel Cleave now deals 120% weapon damage, up from 100%.
[Elune] [Felblade] - Felblade now deals 350% weapon damage, up from 240%.
[Elune] [Execution Sentence] The periodic damage and healing of Execution Sentence can now critically hit.
[Elune] [Arcane Crusade] - The Arcane Explosion empowerment is now guranteed to grant a Missile Barrage charge if the Missile Barrage talent is known.

[Elune] [Arcane Crusade] - The damage empowerment for Arcane Missiles has been increased to 125% against monsters, from 100% and now also affects Seal of Arcane Wrath while channeling a empowered Arcane Missiles.
[Elune] [Divine Concord] - Now increases the damage of Arcane Blast by 75% against monsters, up from 50%.
[Elune] [Seal of Arcane Wrath] - Increased the scaling of the Judgement of Arcane Wrath by 30%.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Spiteful Strike's PvP modifier was not applying. It now correctly applies it's PvP Modifiers. This is now eligible for reset at Gabril.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kalecgos]: Sathrovarr will now remove accumulated damage from Two-Hand Tanks Stagger before sending them back to the normal realm if he "Killed" them.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kalecgos]: Player "dying" in the Spectral Realm now get send back to the normal realm with full health.
[Pending Restart] [Karazhan] [Shade of Aran]: Corrected an issue where Aran would sneakily cast an extra line of Arcane Explosions on full room spirals on Mythic and Ascended difficulty.
[Pending Restart] [Karazhan] [Shade of Aran]: Reduced the chance of getting a Full Room Spiral by 25% on Mythic and Ascended difiiculty.
[Pending Restart] [Karazhan] [Atummen the Huntsmen]: Spectral Steeds now follow a guide trail when running across the battlefield.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Erdar Twins]: Corrected an issue where The Eredar Twins could use Mythic abilities on Normal and Heroic difficulty.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kalecgos]: Corrected an issue where player may got forcefully send back into the Spectral Realm if they would have died to damage taken by their left behind body in the Normal Realm while inside the Spectral Realm on Mythic and Ascended difficulty.

0.description: Reduced Area 52 Manastorm difficulty increase per level by 12%

5.description: [Pending restart and cache clear] Fixed an issue where about 7000 Bloodforged items' stats did not match their normal counterparts.

1.description: [Elune] [Loa's Assault] - Fixed the tooltip of Loa's Assault. It was missing the entry for the Echo of the Windreaver mechanic: Picking up a Shard of Gonk increases the damage of your next Glaive Toss by 20%, stacking 5 times. This damage increase has also been raised to 30%.
[Elune] [Loa's Assault] - Now deals 200% weapon damage, up from 180%.
[Elune] - Loa's Assault now deals 15% less damage in PvP combat.
[Elune] - Execution Sentence (DoT) now deals 30% less damage in PvP combat.
[Elune] - Pulverize now deals 30% less damage in PvP combat.
[Elune] - Fel Cleave now deals 20% less damage in PvP combat.
[Elune] - Felblade now deals 40% less damage in PvP combat.
[Elune] [Bloodcurrent] - Now has a 15% chance to trigger, up from 10%.
[Elune] [Viscera] - Now has a 15% chance to trigger, up from 10%.

[Elune] [Pulverize] - Fixed an issue causing Pulverize to not trigger a global cooldown for other damaging abilities. The damage of Pulverize has been increased by 200%. It now also triggers Enrage for 6 seconds, up from 3. The PVP mod has been increased accordingly.
[Elune] [Hail of Arrows] - Now deals 150% ranged weapon damage, up from 120%. Its cooldown is now 24 seconds, down from 45 seconds.

[Elune] [Blade of the Magisters] - Fist of the Magisters stacks up to 9. And now grants 1 Barrage Overload stack for every 3 stacks of Fist of the Magisters consumed. This means you can gain up to 3 stacks. This requires knowing the Barrage Overload talent.
Fixed a recent bug where healing over time effects could break Stealth.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where the damage increase to Stampede during Bestial Wrath was not working.

5.description: [Pending restart nad cache clear] Fixed the DPS and item level of The Decapitator to match other items from Prince Malchezaar.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Karazhan]: Corrected an issue where Kalecgos was a little to aggressive checking for potential cheaters, eventually teleporting player back to their previous realm when using portals.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kalecgos]: Increased the threat added by Sathrovarr to Kalecgos Human Form inside the Spectral Realm to 1 million up from 100k when a tank leaves the spectral realm or dies in the spectral realm.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins]: Whenever the sisters flash behind a target because it is to far away to atatck, if the target is still not attackable because of elevation, they will give the target a little Boop!.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins]: Sacrolash's spinning clones now inflict weapon damage as shadow damage ina ddition to knocking targets aside with their bladestorma bility and damage inflicted by clones now always applies the owning sisters Lunar or Solar Burn.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins]: The surviving twin now inherits control over the dying twins Lunar or Solar Burn in her merged version.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins]: Corrected an issue where the comabt log would stop to track damage dealt by the vanishing twin as long as she was invisible.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins]: Corrected an issue where Lunar and Solar Burn would not scale with the raids difficulty.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins]: Corrected an issue where the Eredar Twins would cast a false set of spells during their vanish phases.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins]: Improved the Eredar Twins communication with each other.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [High Commander Arynyes]: Vengeful Retaliation now correctly updates damage dealt with every tick, reducing or increasing in damage with each cast depending on Vengeance rather then snapshotting Vengeance on cast start.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [High Commander Arynyes]: High Commander Arynyes can now attack and move while channeling Vengeful Retaliation.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [High Commander Arynyes]: High Commander Arynyes finally understands the difference between front and back-line, casting her conal abilities in the direction she is looking.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Brutallus]: Reduced the spread radius of Burn from 8 to 6 yards.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Brutallus]: Brutallus developed an unreasonable hate against pets, especially turtels, causing him to execute any pet hit by his direct Meteor Slash cast, loosing all excitement and cast another slash right after.
[Pending Restart] [Karazhan] [The Chess Event]: Reworked the Chess Event.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Prince Malchezaar]: Prince Malchezaar will now always respawns his Crystals in the Shadow Realm, even when he can't find a suitable target to send in.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Shade of Aran]: Reworked the final phases Arcane Explosion sequences.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Shade of Aran]: Corrected an issue where Aran could eventually go OoM during his last phase.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Shade of Aran]: Conjured Water Elementals now attack in melee if they are interrupted an their is a target close enough to attack.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Shade of Aran]: Arcane Missiles now has a cast bar.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Curator]: Do NOT touch the displays is now casted 15 seconds earlier and no longer cancels on evocation start.

[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Curator]: Do NOT touch the displays now travels at a constant speed. If Do NOT touch the displays would target a player not on floor level, the curator will now express his unhappiness with Hateful Bolts towards the target.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Curator]: Astral Flares can now fly.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Nightbane]: Nightbane had his hitbox scale increased by x10.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Nightbane]: Nightbane now uses his Vanilla Model on HD Patch, correcting animation issues.

[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Nightbane]: Nightbane will now remove all active Nightfalls from all player if he applies a new Nightfall before the previous one was running out, causing all active Nightfalls to explode.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Nightbane]: Corrected an issue where Nightfall eventually ignored some types of damage reduction.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Nightbane]: Nightbane now flexscales Final Hour per player without break points, inflicting more damage on 11 - 17 player and less damage on 18-24 player.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Nightbane]: Nightbane now takes a maximum amount of damage between flight phases before becomming vulnerable again.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Opera]: Corrected an issue where Julianne and Romulo could stop casting their spells depending on their time of death and ressurection.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Opera]: Corrected an issue where Julianes texts and sounds where miss-matched.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Opera]: Corrected an issue where The Stench of Failure would sometimes spawn underneath the stage or without an visual effect.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [The Opera]: Improved the AIs of all Opera bosses and creatures.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue]: Improved the Maidens selection logic for tanks, healers, melee and ranged dps when casting spells.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue]: Corrected an issue where Blessing of Martyrdom would not work.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Moroes]: Improved the caster AI of Moroes guests.

[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Moroes]: Corrected an issue where the damage inflicted by Starving would be owned by the starving player, eventually causing starving to scale with the players modifiers and not with the bosses or raids modifiers.

[Pending Restart] [Area 52] [Karazhan] [Moroes]: Moroes will now constantly check if "dinner is ready", starting the first dinner as soon as he is allowed to rather then checking on the events cooldown timer.
